news.title: Levers for Increasing College Student Access to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Evidence from Colorado
news.summary_en: In this report, the authors aim to provide federal, state, and local decisionmakers with evidence on four different options for expanding college student participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program.

news.title: College Students and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program in Colorado: Key Findings for State Agencies, Colleges, and Counties
news.summary_en: This brief presents four key findings on Colorado college student participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and the barriers that college students face to participation.

news.title: What Colleges Can Do to Boost Student Participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Lessons from Colorado
news.summary_en: This research brief provides an overview of how Colorado public postsecondary institutions have scaled application and case management support for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and the implications for student participation.

news.title: What States Can Do to Boost College Student Participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Evidence from Colorado
news.summary_en: This brief describes two options that states can pursue to expand college student participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program. Colorado data offer evidence on how these two actions might increase college student participation.

news.title: Will We Know if AI Takes Over? Q&A with Benjamin Boudreaux
news.summary_en: What happens if we off-load our ability to make decisions, to shape the future, to machines? In this Q&A, policy researcher Benjamin Boudreaux discusses how AI could erode human agency over time—and what humans can do to stay in control.

news.title: What Is Blocking U.S. Power Expansion for AI—and What Could Unlock It by 2030?
news.summary_en: Artificial intelligence is increasing electricity demand at a pace that is straining U.S. energy infrastructure. RAND researchers mapped and prioritized barriers to energy expansion in the United States.
